newsitem.title: USA: Restrac sees Q4 shr $0.06 to $0.08.
newsitem.headline: Restrac sees Q4 shr $0.06 to $0.08.

text.p: Restrac Inc said on Tuesday after the market closed that it anticipates net income for its fourth quarter ended September 30, 1996 to be between $.06 to $.08 per share.
The company said it expects total revenues for the quarter to be about $6 million.
A company spokesman said that Restrac, which had an initial public offering in July, had revenues of $4.9 million the previous fourth quarter.
He declined to give a pro forma earnings per share figure for last year's fourth quarter and also delcined to say whether net income would be up or down.
Restrac said revenue is slightly less than expected, and is the result of anticipated sales that did not close prior to the completion of the quarter.
"The shortfall in sales is not the result of competitive pressures or market weakness," said Lars Perkins, president and chief executive officer of Restrac in a press release.
"The demand for our products and services remains strong and the sales pipeline is healthy," he said.
Restrac develops and markets client/server human resource staffing systems.
